snippet.title: PAPER.VOID DEMO RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
== 🎮 WISHLIST PAPER.VOID TODAY! ==
⬜️ PAPER.VOID (Steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4940660/PAPERVOID/
PAPER.VOID Demo (Steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4945940/PAPERVOID_Demo/
PAPER.VOID (Itch.io): https://hushgamesdev.itch.io/papervoid

🟧 HUSH! Games [Discord Server]: https://discord.gg/nCuBbGwaJa

== ⬜ ENTER THE VOID... ==
Navigate an infinite monochrome dimension where many mysteries are yet to be discovered. You are merely a paper plane, flying through space as you destroy universes collect VOID Cubes which further distort the world around you...

The VOID may be infinite, but as you progress further, it becomes increasingly challenging to navigate as you leave behind a permanent deadly trail of light. Your sense of scale, gravity, and depth do not exist here.

When reality reaches its END, can you survive your own self-made labyrinth? Or will your journey lead to an inevitable PAPER CUT...

Features
- Fly through an ever-changing monochrome dimension
- Leave behind a permanent deadly trail
- Survive escalating Void Forms that distort reality
- Collect optional RGB Shards and unlock new paper planes
- Experience an original atmospheric soundtrack
